languages.name: Spanish
languages.motto: The vibrant language of Cervantes, spoken across 20+ countries and 500M+ people worldwide.
languages.description: Master Spanish through the official MCER / Instituto Cervantes curriculum spanning 20 leveled units across A1 (Beginner), A2 (Elementary), B1 (Intermediate), B2 (Upper-Intermediate), and C1/C2 (Mastery).

languages.name: French
languages.motto: The language of diplomacy, romance, gastronomy, and international arts.
languages.description: Immerse yourself in French culture with Parisian elegance, café dialogue, and fluent pronunciation secrets.

languages.name: German
languages.motto: The powerhouse language of engineering, philosophy, literature, and European commerce.
languages.greeting: Guten Tag! Wie geht es Ihnen?
languages.description: Master German through the official BAMF Rahmencurriculum (Integrationskurs DaZ) and DeuFöV Berufssprachkurse spanning 10 leveled units across A1, A2, B1, B2, and C1/C2 (TestDaF/DSH).

languages.name: Japanese
languages.motto: The graceful language of harmony, anime, ancient Shinto shrines, and cutting-edge innovation.
languages.greeting: こんにちは！お元気ですか？
languages.description: Master Japanese through the official JF Standard (Japan Foundation) and JLPT (N5 to N2) / MEXT national framework, featuring 6 leveled units, 24 lessons, 240 leveled flashcards, and official CBT examination simulation.

languages.name: Mandarin Chinese
languages.motto: The profound language of ancient dynasties, modern global trade, and over 1.1 billion speakers.
languages.description: Learn Mandarin Chinese structured with the official GF 0025-2021 standards (HSK 1-9 & HSKK oral exam) governed by the Ministry of Education (PRC) & CLEC, covering Syllables, Characters, Vocabulary, Grammar, and Cultural Pragmatics.

languages.name: Nigerian Pidgin
languages.motto: The most expressive, energetic lingua franca across West Africa!
languages.description: Learn the vibrant language spoken by over 75 million people across Nigeria, West Africa, and global Afrobeat culture — structured with the NERDC 4-Tier Oracy, Grammar, and Literature framework.

languages.name: Yoruba
languages.motto: A tonal, poetic language of royal traditions, respect, and ancient wisdom.
languages.description: Discover one of Africa's most influential languages, renowned for its melodic tones, respect systems (ọ̀wọ̀), and rich philosophical proverbs.

languages.name: Portuguese
languages.motto: The melodic language of maritime explorers, fado ballads, and 260M+ speakers worldwide.
languages.description: Master Portuguese through the official Adult Vocational Syllabus (PLA / IEFP Standard) and Primary/Secondary School Syllabus (DGE Standard) across 6 units (30 lessons), 240 flashcards, and CAPLE CIPLE/DIPLE CBT exam simulations.

languages.name: Swedish
languages.motto: The harmonious Nordic tongue of balance (Lagom), archipelago islands, and innovation.
languages.description: Master Swedish through official Skolverket and UHR curricula: Track A (SFI Kurs B–D, SVA & Tisus Standard) and Track B (Grundskolan Lgr22 & Gymnasiet SVA 3) across 6 units (24 lessons), 240 flashcards, culture vault, and CBT exam simulations.

languages.name: Finnish
languages.motto: The mystical Uralic language of resilient grit (Sisu), midnight suns, and thousand lakes.
languages.description: Discover Finnish with Northern Lights wonders, sauna etiquette, and unique phonetic harmony.

languages.name: Igbo
languages.motto: The entrepreneurial, rhythmic tonal language of southeastern Nigeria and rich masquerade heritage.
languages.description: Master Igbo greetings, respect for elders, vibrant commercial trade phrases, and deep philosophical proverbs.

languages.name: Hausa
languages.motto: The major Afroasiatic trade language spoken by 80M+ people across West & Central Africa.
languages.description: Discover Hausa with trans-Saharan trade warmth, royal Emirates greetings, and market eloquence.
